notes.en: [[character:hugo]] is paired best with Stunners that apply a lot of Daze and also give valuable damage buffs. Each W-Engine shows two figures: damage first, Daze second, relative to his signature.
Target stats at level 60: ATK 2,600 to 3,000+, HP 10,000+, DEF 800+, CRIT Rate 70 to 88% and CRIT DMG 160 to 200%+.
[[character:lighter]], [[character:lycaon]] and [[character:trigger]] provide the best of both worlds. Pair 2 of the 3 with Hugo. [[character:qingyi]] and [[character:pulchra]] also work.

[[character:dialyn]] is a particularly strong option, since much of her buffs are concentrated in the Stun period. Most Hugo teams depend on Lighter for best performance, but her Stun extension means she can replace him.

[[character:soukaku]] and [[character:astra-yao]] do not give Hugo the extra ATK buff from his Core Passive and do not generate a lot of Daze, which may lower the number of Stun windows per fight. They are still good supports.
The W-Engine ranking was calculated with [[character:lighter]] (Blazing Laurel) and [[character:dialyn]] (Yesterday Calls).
